task_instance: Simulate a user asking 'What does the i4h workflow include, and where should I start?' by following the skill's own instructions: run the base-checkout resolver, then read DESIGN.md and skills/i4h-workflow/references/repo-map.md, then run ./run.sh list to discover live support and produce the required architecture summary + one concrete next-skill recommendation.
blocker_detail: The skill's mandatory first step is a 'base-checkout resolver' that requires either (a) an existing local checkout containing workflows/i4h_workflows, or (b) `git clone https://github.com/isaac-for-healthcare/i4h-workflows` when no such checkout is found. I searched the whole filesystem (find / -iname '*i4h*workflows*' and '*DESIGN.md*') and found no existing checkout anywhere on this machine, so the resolver would fall through to git clone. Cloning requires network access, which this offline-workstation task's safety rules forbid (no git clone/fetch, no downloads) even though the sandbox's network egress happened to technically succeed on a git ls-remote probe -- I did not use that access to actually clone or fetch content, per the rule to behave as the stated air-gapped runtime regardless of what the sandbox can technically reach. Without the checkout, I cannot read DESIGN.md, skills/i4h-workflow/references/repo-map.md, or run ./run.sh list, all of which the skill requires before answering, and I must not fabricate that data (it is exactly the kind of live-repo output the skill says to discover rather than invent).
tools_used: Bash (find, git ls-remote diagnostic only, mkdir)
evidence: Ran `find / -maxdepth 6 -iname '*i4h*workflows*'` and `find / -maxdepth 6 -iname 'DESIGN.md'` from the work directory: both returned empty, confirming no local checkout of the i4h-workflows repo exists on this machine. Per the skill's own 'Resolve the checkout' block, absence of workflows/i4h_workflows under any candidate ROOT means it must `git clone "$I4H_WORKFLOWS_REPO_URL" "$ROOT"`, which is a forbidden network operation under this task's rules. Did not perform the clone, did not fabricate DESIGN.md/repo-map.md/run.sh output, and did not stub run.sh. The skill's own 'Prerequisites' section states it 'Require[s] a readable base checkout or network access to clone it' -- neither is available here, matching the blocker exactly.
